💚 Shaping the future of sustainable digital banking 💚

Launched in 2014 as one of the UK’s original challenger banks, Tandem is proudly headquartered in the Northwest, with over 500 people working across the UK. 

People join Tandem because they want to shape something meaningful. Here, you’ll use your skills to create products that empower people to make better financial choices and lower their environmental impact. We’re big enough to drive real change, small enough for every voice to be heard, and united by a shared purpose that inspires us to move forward - together. 

Recognised in The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for 2024 and 2025, Tandem has also been named in The Sunday Times 100 Tech list for two consecutive years in 2025 and 2026 – a list of the fastest growing tech companies in Britain, reflective of our growing industry presence.   • Adherence to and promotion of a culture of treating our customers fairly to deliver fair outcomes.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewLynker is seeking a talented Meteorologist and Data Scientist Developer to support a long term contract at the Weather Prediction Center (WPC) and will have direct interaction with scientists within NOAA as well as partners outside of NOAA.
jobs.description:
Overview

Lynker is seeking a talented Meteorologist and Data Scientist Developer to support a long term contract at the Weather Prediction Center (WPC) and will have direct interaction with scientists within NOAA as well as partners outside of NOAA. This includes: NCEP centers, NWS weather forecast offices, NOAA research facilities, academia, and the NWS Science and Operations Officer community. In this capacity the incumbent will work with these partners to develop and implement verification methods to gauge the effectiveness of new forecaster tools applied to operational and experimental forecasts. The work will also strive to build the capacity to enhance impact decision support services (IDSS), effectively building a Weather Ready Nation. The role will also focus on leveraging machine learning techniques to enhance forecasting capabilities. This includes leading projects that apply advanced AI algorithms to predictive modeling.

In addition, the incumbent will work to provide enhancements that build upon current forecaster tools as well as work to develop new services and forecaster tools. Promising work will be transitioned to operations. The incumbent will provide training materials on the enhanced forecaster products and tools. The incumbent will specifically employ machine learning models to improve existing tools and pioneer new, data-driven services.

Areas of particular need and interest to be addressed include developing forecaster and verification tools for hazardous weather. Additional areas of focus include the use of ensemble model output to aid forecaster generation of probabilistic products. A key focus will be integrating AI and machine learning workflows to optimize the processing of ensemble model output and other complex meteorological datasets. This also entails applying neural networks to enhance high-resolution numerical weather prediction models.

The ideal Meteorologist and Data Scientist Developer will be able to identify pertinent datasets (satellite, land use, and meteorological) and develop forecaster tools which may be implemented on web pages or within the forecaster platforms. Assignments are typically received in terms of expected outcomes, and incumbents are expected to act independently to develop methodologies, and to provide sound analyses and recommendations. Assigned projects may include analysis, application development, or other areas specific to the assignment. The ideal candidate will also leverage AI-driven data pipelines to automate the ingestion and preprocessing of vast meteorological datasets.

Responsibilities

Duties of the Meteorologist and Data Scientist Developer will include the following:

  • Collaborate with meteorologists at NCEP, NWS field offices, academia, and outside partners to develop forecast tools for short to medium range time frames regarding hazardous weather.
  • Use scientific and technical meteorological expertise to develop tools for determination of hazard information.
  • As appropriate, contribute to formal scientific publications, and/or attending off-site conferences, symposia and hazardous-weather-related outreach events.
  • Collaborate to transition forecaster tools developed at WPC and elsewhere within NOAA into operations at WPC and other NOAA offices.
  • Develop web applications using modern industry languages and tools such as, GIS, Python, and PHP.
  • Develop training materials to transition new tools and techniques into operations.
  • Perform related duties as assigned.
  • Design and train machine learning models to identify precursors to hazardous weather events.
  • Implement AI-based anomaly detection systems to identify errors or gaps in real-time forecast data.

Qualifications

The Meteorologist and Data Scientist Developer selected should have the following:

  • A degree (e.g. B.S. or B.A.) from an accredited institution in Atmospheric Science, Oceanography, or other Geophysical Sciences, Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Mathematics and have at least 2 years of experience in related areas.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) techniques to analyze and model complex environmental or meteorological datasets.
  • Experience with software development support in a team environment
  • Experience with Python and Unix shell scripting within a UNIX/Linux Environment.
  • Knowledge of deterministic and ensemble prediction system data sets and their application to hazardous weather diagnosis and prediction.
  • Knowledge of weather forecasting - short to medium range
  • Ability to organize, plan, and complete projects
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills for documentation and presentations
  • Ability to support team initiatives, demonstrate respect for team members, and seek team consensus

The Ideal Meteorologist and Data Scientist Developer will have the following:

  • Experience with development Frameworks for web based map applications ( e.g. ArcGIS, JavaScript, API)
  • Proficiency in data science frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn, and experience with deep learning applications in weather prediction.

About Lynker

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The 'Pronto' team serves as the UK's leading provider of mobile policing applications, supporting 50% of the country's 45 police forces and over 70,000 active officers each day. The Hosted Applications team takes primary responsibility for managing the Pronto application across the hosted environment. Our dedicated group remotely oversees these Pronto instances for all hosted customers, directly ensuring platform stability, driving optimal performance, and maintaining continuous operational monitoring.


Job Description

This role is primarily remote, with occasional travel to offices.

Operating within Motorola Solutions’ Hosted Applications Team, the Systems Engineer holds a highly technical role combining application lifecycle engineering with client-facing responsibilities. Leveraging over 3 years of engineering expertise, you will share accountability for managing and sustaining the operational resilience of the mission-critical Pronto Digital Policing application for frontline emergency services and police forces.

In this position, you will assist with key deployment initiatives for standard product enhancements and customised client features. You will act as a technical link between software engineering and shared platform services teams while maintaining direct customer engagement. Key responsibilities involve assisting in analysing software issues, supporting patch rollouts and release cycles, and contributing customer feedback towards application enhancements.

Serving as a technical point of contact, you will support client-facing operations, help align infrastructure and application workflows, and participate in technical discussions during weekly meetings and service reviews. You will also monitor platform health and key performance metrics to help uphold strict Service Level Agreement (SLA) standards, working alongside project managers to resolve technical issues for customers.

You will help maintain SQL Server clusters, which house essential Pronto application data. You will support data security, system reliability, and standard operational processes aligned with the daily needs of our police and emergency service teams.

Key responsibilities of Systems Engineer:

  • Service Reviews & Client Engagement:Participate in regular customer service reviews and weekly meetings with key police force stakeholders to assist in presenting system performance, address operational concerns, and support customer satisfaction efforts.

  • SLA & Delivery Oversight:Assist in monitoring system performance against agreed contractual SLAs, supporting team efforts to minimise downtime and prevent service-impacting incidents.

  • Software Engineering Liaison:Act as an operational liaison for the core Pronto Software Engineering team. Help gather operational insights and support release management activities, including application hotfixes, feature rollouts, and platform deployments.

  • Shared Services Collaboration:Work closely with the internal Shared Services team to align application demands with technical specifications and assist in submitting change requests as needed.

  • Documentation:Contribute to and maintain customer-facing Interface Control Documents (ICDs), detailing technical specifications and protocols required for external system integration with the Pronto platform.

  • Problem & Incident Management:Support the incident management team in investigating and resolving system issues, helping implement effective solutions and preventative measures.

  • Continuous Learning & Knowledge Sharing: Engage in active knowledge sharing within the team, participating in peer learning and documenting technical workflows to support team development.


Basic Requirements

  • Experience:3+ years of progressive experience in Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Hosted Application Operations within enterprise or public safety environments.

  • Security Clearance: Must be eligible for and maintain regional security vetting (e.g., UK NPPV Level 3 and SC Clearance for public safety cloud environments).

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, System Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Driver's License: Must hold a valid driver's license and own a vehicle for travel to customer sites.

  • On-Call Support:Must be willing and available to participate in an on-call rotation to support mission-critical systems and emergency operational needs.

Technical requirements:

  • Architecture & System Lifecycle:Understanding of enterprise architecture principles, end-to-end system workflows, and standard software deployment lifecycle practices.

  • Cloud & Hosting Environments:Hands-on experience supporting hosted application environments across AWS, Azure, or Private Cloud infrastructure.

  • OS & Web Infrastructure: Practical experience administering Windows and Linux operating systems, along with working knowledge of web/application servers, SSL/TLS certificates.

  • Database Management:Practical capability in supporting, querying, and resolving operational issues within enterprise relational databases (such as SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL).

  • Automation & Scripting:Proficiency using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to assist with routine tasks, build basic automation scripts, and monitor application health.

  • Observability & Telemetry:Familiarity with maintaining and using enterprise monitoring tools (such as Grafana, Prometheus, or the TIG stack) to maintain visibility over system health.

  • Incident Resolution & Diagnostics:Strong problem-solving and diagnostic skills to troubleshoot system incidents and support root cause analysis.

  • Stakeholder Alignment & Communication:Effective communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional technical teams, convey technical updates clearly, and support client interactions.

​In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching & development every step of the way. Also, to reward your hard work you’ll get:

    You will help build the core data infrastructure for Binance's stock and related financial market businesses, responsible for the full pipeline—from data source discovery, evaluation, and ingestion, to unified modeling, real-time processing, quality governance, and data services.     Own the research, technical evaluation, ingestion, cleansing, standardization, computation, storage, and servicing of financial market data, covering securities master data, real-time and historical market quotes, fundamentals, corporate actions, indices, and product/risk data as required by the business. For content-type data such as announcements, news, and research reports, own source ingestion, raw retention, and stable delivery to the knowledge engineering pipeline.

    Design scalable unified data models and ingestion frameworks that handle varying market conventions for trading calendars, time zones, currencies, security identifiers, listing relationships, lifecycle events, and data corrections, enabling rapid onboarding of new markets and sources.

Collaborate with product, procurement, legal, and compliance teams to define boundaries for usage, display, derivation, storage, and redistribution, and drive reasonable primary/backup source and fallback strategies.

    Partner with trading product, data platform, AI engineering, and algorithm teams to jointly define data semantics, metric definitions, and service contracts, ensuring that the same stock facts can be used consistently and reliably across different products.

    Drive data engineering efficiency and technical quality improvements, including metadata management, data lineage, automated testing, CI/CD, task orchestration, capacity governance, and AI-assisted development.

Able to explain the full pipeline of at least one type of financial data from source to end-user product, including key quality risks.

    Proficient in SQL and Flink, with experience in large-scale real-time data processing, performance tuning, stability governance, and production issue troubleshooting.

    Proficient in at least one of Java, Scala, or Python; familiar with Kafka, Spark, and distributed storage/analytics technologies such as ClickHouse, Doris, HBase, Elasticsearch, or similar.

    Familiar with data modeling, task scheduling, metadata, data lineage, data governance, and service levels; able to independently resolve cross-system data consistency issues.

    Holds high standards for data quality, capable of designing reproducible reconciliation, anomaly detection, backfill, and degradation strategies—not just completing data development tasks.

    Has experience with data source selection or production ingestion, able to articulate trade-offs between buy vs. build, multi-source verification, vendor dependency, and fallback alternatives.

    Strong business understanding and cross-team collaboration skills; able to translate trading, risk, research, or AI problems into clear data models and data contracts.

The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.

Your Impact

Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:

  • Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.

  • Understands Key customer business requirements and has the ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio solutions creating business value for customers.

  • Ability to drive customer adoption of Palo Alto Networks Platform. Building customer relationships by helping customers achieve increased productivity, operational efficiency, security efficacy, and greater flexibility to innovate.

  • Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers

  • Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.

  • Demonstrating strong communication skills, influencing through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, and conducts technical engagements and workshops that are clear and impactful, simplifying complex ideas for various audiences

  • Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.

  • Demonstrates Cross functional leadership driving collaboration and orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy.

  • Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner

  • Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating PANW's leadership in the cybersecurity space

  • Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events

  • Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Skilled in at least one of the following Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint or SASE.

  • Experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives is preferred

  • Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal

  • Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements

  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies

  • Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions

  • Experience in complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred

  • This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.

  • High level of German language skills. Business fluent in English

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Vem ser Flamingo! ✨

  • Aprendizado acelerado: cada desafio é uma chance de crescer e inovar.
  • Pertencimento de verdade: ninguém voa sozinho, sempre em formação.
  • Sentido de propósito: o que começa na Flash transforma o jeito que o mundo trabalha.
  • Deixe sua marca no mundo do trabalho e viva com a gente o poder de fazer voar.

✨ Nossos benefícios:

jobs.excerpt: As our Solution Deployment Manager, you are part of our Implementation team, which plays a key role in onboarding seamlessly new customers: they are working cross department (Sales, Product and Customer Success) to understand and document client use cases and requirements and then translate them into set up and configuration of the 360Learning platform.
jobs.description:
As our Solution Deployment Manager, you are part of our Implementation team, which plays a key role in onboarding seamlessly new customers: they are working cross department (Sales, Product and Customer Success) to understand and document client use cases and requirements and then translate them into set up and configuration of the 360Learning platform.
You will manage all phases of the implementation lifecycle, from sales turnover and kick off to handover to support. You will drive project management, define 360Learning platform architecture for our clients, facilitate integrations (flat files, API’s) and 3rd party apps, guide and provide assistance in order to ensure the successful deployment of their platform.
In addition, you will follow your customers' portfolio along their contract to increase product adoption, as well as to deliver Solutions complementary to the Product like platform audits.

Within 1 month, you will:

  • Become a Trello expert through our onboarding process
  • Understand our product offering through training
  • Master our platform and be able to support clients on basics requests through ticketing

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Start to onboard your own new clients
  • Drive project management in order to ensure successful platform deployment from Kick-off meeting, regular touchpoints until handover to support
  • Host functional and technical workshops with clients to support them in their platform customization and structuring

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Successfully ensure 360Learning platform deployment for new clients
  • Successfully implement integration (SSO, third-party tools), deliver technical expertise on how to integrate their learning platform to their technical environment & troubleshooting
  • Be able to pitch the value of the 360Learning platform
  • Develop repeatable and scalable processes to improve project quality and delivery
  • Support Strategic customers all along their contract from un expertise standpoint
  • Deliver Professional Services to our existing customers base

Within 12 months, you will:

  • Onboard another Solution Deployment Manager
  • Contribute to our knowledge base to share best practices and lessons learned
  • Work with our partner ecosystem to strengthen the services proposed to our clients
  • Deliver platform audits to clients
  • Deliver professional services proposed in our Professional Service catalogue

The Skills Set

  • Minimum 3 years experience in a similar, preferably customer facing role (Technical Consultant, Technical Account Manager, Implementation Project Manager or Pre-sales Consultant)
  • Previous deployment experience of SaaS products, ideally HR related
  • Project management skills
  • Understanding and experience working with APIs, SSO configuration & troubleshooting
  • Solution-oriented, client-first mindset in everything you do
  • Ability to adapt to your audience, flexibility in tackling a conversation with highly technical stakeholders, and reducing complexity to more common terms with less technical stakeholders.
  • Organized, structured, rational, analytical, able to manage priorities across multiple customer implementations,
  • Fluent French and very good English proficiency (level B2)
  • Enthusiasm for our culture explained:

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision what's it like to join 360Learning through our onboarding journey: & Convexity Culture: 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

Interview Process

  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with Solution Deployment Manager Coach
  • Case Study Meeting with 2 Solution Deployment Managers
  • Clarification Meeting with our Head of Professional Services
  • Culture Fit Meeting with our Chief Human Resources Officer
  • Offer !
    • ⇾ Get ready using our Knowledge Base:

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. jobs.title: Head of Integration & Scaling (w/m/d)
jobs.excerpt: Du möchtest Wachstum aktiv gestalten und Unternehmen erfolgreich in eine starke Unternehmensgruppe integrieren?
jobs.description:
Du möchtest Wachstum aktiv gestalten und Unternehmen erfolgreich in eine starke Unternehmensgruppe integrieren? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Head of Integration & Scaling (w/m/d) - Berlin oder Remote in Deutschland

Als Head of Integration & Scaling (w/m/d) verbindest Du die Wachstumsstrategie der Arsipa Gruppe mit der operativen Weiterentwicklung unserer Tochtergesellschaften. Von der Akquisition bis zur vollständigen Integration steuerst Du zentrale Post-Merger-Integration-Projekte und entwickelst skalierbare Strukturen für IT, Finance, People und Operations. Dabei bringst Du lokale Stärken mit den Standards und digitalen Plattformen der Gruppe zusammen, identifizierst Synergien und machst Fortschritte anhand klarer KPIs transparent. Im engen Austausch mit den Geschäftsführungen unserer Partnerunternehmen und den zentralen Teams schaffst Du Akzeptanz für neue Prozesse und sorgst für eine nachhaltige Umsetzung. Dafür brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung!

Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

Steuerung der Post-Merger-Integration

  • Integrationspläne für neue Partnerunternehmen und Standorte entwickelst und verantwortest Du für die Bereiche IT, Finance, People und Operations.

  • Neue Partnerunternehmen begleitest Du von der Akquisition bis zur vollständigen Integration in die Arsipa-Plattform.

  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Wachstumsstrategie und operativer Umsetzung koordinierst Du die Zusammenarbeit der beteiligten Fachbereiche.

  • Gegenüber den Geschäftsführungen unserer Tochtergesellschaften trittst Du als zentrale Ansprechperson auf und schaffst Akzeptanz für gruppenweite Prozesse.

Skalierung der Operations

  • Bewährte Vorgehensweisen innerhalb der Gruppe identifizierst Du und überführst sie in einheitliche Standard Operating Procedures.

  • Skalierbare Strukturen und effiziente Workflows baust Du auf und entwickelst sie entsprechend der Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe weiter.

  • Synergien innerhalb unseres Netzwerks erkennst Du frühzeitig und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur operativen Skalierung ab.

  • Lokale Stärken verbindest Du mit zentralen Gruppenstandards, um Skaleneffekte an unseren Standorten nutzbar zu machen.

Digitale Transformation und Performance

  • Gemeinsam mit unserem Tech-Team migrierst Du bestehende Systeme auf unsere digitalen Plattformen für Dokumentation, Terminsteuerung und Reporting.

  • Die Transformation analoger Geschäftsmodelle zu digital ausgerichteten Abläufen steuerst Du strukturiert und praxisnah.

  • Geeignete KPIs definierst und verfolgst Du, um den Integrationserfolg und den Fortschritt der operativen Skalierung messbar zu machen.

  • Auf Basis der gewonnenen Daten identifizierst Du Ineffizienzen und belegst den wirtschaftlichen Beitrag Deiner Initiativen.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Mindestens sechs Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Post-Merger-Integration, Managementberatung oder einer führenden Operations-Rolle in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmensumfeld bilden Deine fachliche Grundlage.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen sowie in der Optimierung komplexer Prozesse und Workflows bringst Du mit.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Überzeugungsstärke ermöglichen Dir, funktionsübergreifende Teams sicher durch Veränderungs- und Integrationsprozesse zu führen.

  • Eine pragmatische, umsetzungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise hilft Dir, Integrationsengpässe zu lösen und Entscheidungen anhand klarer KPIs zu treffen.

Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

  • Erfahrung im Healthcare-, MedTech- oder Professional-Services-Umfeld wäre von Vorteil.

  • Ein beruflicher Hintergrund in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld mit Buy-&-Build-Strategie ist wünschenswert.

  • Erfahrung bei der Weiterentwicklung analoger Geschäftsmodelle hin zu digital ausgerichteten Organisationen wäre ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführungen und zentralen Fachbereichen bei unternehmensübergreifenden Integrations- oder Transformationsprojekten würde Dein Profil ergänzen.

Unsere Benefits:

  • Flexibles Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei sowie ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell mit der Möglichkeit, deutschlandweit remote zu arbeiten. Für den persönlichen Austausch steht Dir unser zentral gelegenes Office im Berliner Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, direkt an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“, zur Verfügung.

  • Direkter Einfluss auf unsere Buy-&-Build-Strategie: In einer zentralen Schlüsselrolle gestaltest Du die Integration neuer Partnerunternehmen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform aktiv mit und leistest damit einen direkten Beitrag zur Wachstumsstrategie der Arsipa Gruppe.

  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entwickelst Integrationsprozesse, Strukturen und Standards nicht nur weiter, sondern kannst sie maßgeblich mitgestalten und gruppenweit etablieren. Dabei hast Du die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und nachhaltige Veränderungen umzusetzen.

  • Zusammenarbeit auf Managementebene: Du arbeitest eng mit den Geschäftsführungen unserer Tochtergesellschaften sowie den zentralen Teams aus M&A, Finance, People, IT und Operations zusammen und begleitest zentrale Transformations- und Integrationsprojekte über verschiedene Unternehmensbereiche hinweg.

  • Dynamisches Private-Equity-Umfeld: Du erhältst unmittelbare Einblicke in die Weiterentwicklung einer schnell wachsenden, von Warburg Pincus unterstützten Unternehmensgruppe und gestaltest die Skalierung einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden aktiv mit.

  • Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Neben einer marktgerechten Vergütung profitierst Du von unserem Corporate-Benefits-Programm mit zahlreichen Angeboten und Vergünstigungen.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess:

  1. Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe.

  2. Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner*innen aus dem Fachbereich Integration & Scaling.

  3. Persönliches Kennenlernen mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner*innen aus dem Fachbereich Integration & Scaling und dem Management.

Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung!

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, have a passion for creating value for customers, and excel at building relationships, this role may be your opportunity to fuel your success. You'll work with a dynamic team, evolve your skills, and contribute to a company that values innovation and customer success.
In this role, you will

Work you’ll do:

Establish and maintain influential, long-term relationships with other key stakeholders, including executive leadership, IT departments, and operational staff.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, orchestrating seamless collaboration with Panopto's executive leadership, Product Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure exceptional customer experiences and the successful realization of strategic initiatives.

  • Complex Problem Solving & Advocacy: Serve as the ultimate escalation point for complex customer challenges, demonstrating an unwavering commitment to understanding, resolving, and advocating for client needs with speed and efficacy.
  • Thought Leadership & Market Intelligence: Maintain a profound understanding of industry landscapes, including emergent trends, policy shifts, competitive dynamics, and technological advancements within the LMS and VCMS sectors. Leverage this expertise to guide customer strategies and inform Panopto's product roadmap.
  • Enterprise-Level Negotiations: Lead and successfully close complex enterprise-level renewal agreements and expansion proposals, demonstrating superior negotiation and presentation skills.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, SaaS Technology, or a related field. MBA or Master's degree is highly preferred.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in strategic account management or enterprise sales, with a proven track record of securing and expanding multi-million dollar accounts.
  • Extensive, hands-on experience working with and influencing executive-level stakeholders utilizing complex Learning Management Systems (LMS) and/or Video Content Management Systems (VCMS).

  • Possess a profound understanding of the unique operational, financial and policy-related dynamics within large organizations, paired with a results-driven, entrepreneurial mindset focused relentlessly on exceeding targets and delivering tangible value. Demonstrating the ability to thrive independently in fast-paced, dynamic environments while fostering collaborative success across internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in a Forward-thinking role within an LMS or VCMS provider.
  • Documented success in navigating complex procurement processes within commercial and enterprise organizations.

The Team:

You will be an integral part of a dynamic, high-performing and strategically focused team, reporting to the Director of Account Management. We operate with a customer-obsessed mindset, working in close partnership with our Customer Experience and executive leadership teams to ensure our clients not only succeed but thrive with Panopto.
Join Panopto and be part of an exciting journey where you’ll become a key architect of our growth trajectory, directly influencing the success of our customers. If you possess a vigorous strategic orientation and a passion for driving impactful executive-level relationships, we invite you to apply.

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuableRecruiting Tipsfrom our team.

The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently:

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Panopto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified individuals which will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Panopto is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation for interviewing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please provide more detail on how we can further support you by reaching out to the Employee Experience department.

Remote, US: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely.

Remote, International: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely. Still, they may make regular trips to the local international office from time to time, where applicable.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

jobs.excerpt: Our missionWe're making Africa the first cashless continent.
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder.

AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works.

The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will:

  • Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers.
  • Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact.
  • Drive user research within our engineering and product teams.
  • Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making.
  • Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment.
  • Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings.
  • Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes.

In this role, you'll...

  • Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.
  • Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction.
  • Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.
  • Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs.
  • Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.
  • Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely.
  • Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support co-working meetups with teammates.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per year. Exceptions apply, but we’ve found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you’ve shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you:
    • Have proven experience with successfully rolling out AI-based solutions in a larger org
    • Have professional experience in a consumer fintech company

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are continuously iterating on using AI in real workflows with honest evaluation.
  • Are a strong communicator who can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you’ve seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don’t just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

jobs.excerpt: What if you could personally impact the future of healthcare?
jobs.description:
What if you could personally impact the future of healthcare? As part of the PocketHealth team, you will enable hospitals and clinics across North America — and more importantly, empower over 2 million patients — to discover a better healthcare experience.
PocketHealth is a patient-centric platform that enables hospitals and clinics across North America to share imaging records digitally with patients, instantly and securely. Through our platform, we enable patients to be active and engaged participants in their own care, and take control of their care journey. In addition to image sharing, which is the heart of the PocketHealth platform, we’ve grown our core functionality to enable sharing between hospitals and physicians, as well as instant image retrieval and automated importing capability. PocketHealth is a unified image management solution for over 800 hospitals and clinics across North America. We believe that by placing patients at the center of the record release process, data moves more ethically, easily and securely throughout the care journey, and we’re looking for passionate individuals to help make this vision a reality for millions more patients across North America.
We’re looking for an independent, self-motivated, and ambitious Patient Experience Representative with a sincere passion for healthcare to help us grow and directly support patients in their care journey. This isn’t your average Customer Support role. Empathetic and timely support for our patient population is at the heart of what we do and we view it as fundamental to our continued success. That means we’re looking for an ambitious self-starter who is comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment.
Understanding how our patients interact with our platform lays a great foundation for growth into any role in the company, so this position is ideal for someone who wants to grow into a leadership role over time and take on new challenges as PocketHealth grows globally. Previous Patient Experience Reps have moved onto high-impact roles in Customer Success, UI/UX and Engineering within the company.
This job posting is for an existing vacancy. The salary for this position is $45,000 -$48,000 annually. Salary is just one part of the story, though; this role is also eligible for equity in the form of stock options and includes a comprehensive health and benefits package. We view our compensation as a total investment in your well-being, designed to support you both in your work and in your life outside of it.

About You:

  • Ability to work Saturday to Wednesday, 9am to 5pm EST
  • Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written)
  • Minimum of 2-3 years in a customer service role with communication over phone and email (mandatory)
  • Outstanding organizational skills and an ability to juggle multiple tasks
  • Experience with or passion for healthcare would be an asset, but is not required
  • Technical Support experience considered an asset

Nice to haves:

  • Resourceful, flexible, hold yourself accountable and persevere in the face of obstacles
  • Hardworking and eagerly embrace the challenge of solving problems
  • Empathetic and enjoy teaching people at all levels of technical proficiency
  • A standout teammate – someone who believes in working with their team to achieve shared goals
  • Communication skills in Spanish or French (verbal and written) - not required, but would be an asset

Outcomes:

  • Patient Support: Provide timely technical support, guidance around appropriate use and general platform education to patients via email and over the phone. You will be a key contact for patients looking to access their health records and navigate the PocketHealth platform.
  • Product Vision: Use the feedback you’ve gathered from patients and providers to help our Management and Engineering teams shape the future of the PocketHealth platform.
You can do amazing things at PocketHealth. You can positively impact the healthcare journey for millions of people, while building your career and developing your skills. It doesn’t have to be one or the other. It has been a part of our mission since our founding to empower patients & make healthcare accessible to all, and we know this can only be achieved with a team of diverse perspectives that is representative of the Patient & Provider communities we serve.
People love working here for these reasons and more: working remotely, our competitive salaries and benefits (including stock options for every employee!), four weeks of paid time off, unlimited paid wellness days, extended mental health coverage, and 16 weeks of parental leave top-up.
We’re proud to foster a culture that embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we believe in caring for our employees with the same thoughtfulness we offer our Patients & Providers.

Our Culture Empowers YOU!

We hire people passionate about what they do, provide them with the tools to succeed, and then get out of their way! Living our vision, mission, and values, our people are what make Jackrabbit Technologies an awesome place to work. And that “awesome place” is virtual -- all of our employees enjoy the privilege of working remotely. We always have and always will. So, you must have reliable high-speed internet access. What You'll Do:

The Total Rewards & People Experience Manager is a senior, hands-on People & Culture professional responsible for designing, implementing, administering, and continuously improving programs that help Jackrabbit attract, reward, develop, support, and retain employees. This role combines deep Total Rewards expertise with broad HR management capability and serves as a trusted operational partner to employees, managers, and leaders across the organization.

The role has primary ownership for compensation, benefits, recognition, career development frameworks, work-life and wellbeing programs, leaves of absence, and workplace accommodations.

In addition to its Total Rewards specialty, this role functions as a hands-on HR Manager and day-to-day business partner, working closely with the Director, People & Culture to support employee relations, performance management, manager coaching, learning and development, onboarding and offboarding, employee experience, and HR operations. The Manager also serves as a knowledgeable backup for payroll and helps build durable People practices, systems, vendor relationships, and operating processes that can scale with Jackrabbit’s growth.

Success in this role requires someone who can move comfortably between program design and hands-on execution. This is a high-trust role requiring sound judgment, strong business partnership, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to a thoughtful employee experience.

Key Responsibilities:

Total Rewards Strategy, Compensation & Job Architecture

  • Partner with the Director, People & Culture and company leadership to develop and continuously evolve a Total Rewards approach that supports Jackrabbit’s business strategy, culture, talent needs, and financial priorities.

Benefits, Wellbeing, Leave & Accommodations

  • Own the day-to-day administration and ongoing evolution of employee health, welfare, retirement, wellbeing, and related benefit programs.
  • Lead benefits renewal and open enrollment activities, including plan evaluation, implementation, communications, education, system configuration, and follow-through.
  • Partner with brokers, carriers, vendors, Finance, and internal stakeholders to implement and maintain benefit plan structures, resolve issues, monitor service, and support accurate administration.
  • Evaluate utilization, employee feedback, market practices, cost trends, and program effectiveness and recommend changes that balance employee experience, competitiveness, compliance, and cost.
  • Manage leaves of absence and workplace accommodation processes from intake through return to work, coordinating with employees, managers, vendors, and other partners as appropriate.
  • Maintain working knowledge of applicable benefits, leave, disability, accommodation, and related employment requirements across Jackrabbit’s jurisdictions.

Recognition, Career Development & People Experience

  • Design and maintain scalable recognition practices that reinforce Jackrabbit’s values and recognize meaningful contribution and impact.
  • Build and maintain career development frameworks, including career ladders, lattices, and role-level expectations, that create clarity around growth and mobility.
  • Partner with leaders and employees to connect career frameworks with development planning and internal mobility and support broader succession and talent discussions led by the Director, People & Culture and company leadership.
  • Use employee feedback, workforce data, program outcomes, and external practices to identify and recommend improvements to the employee experience, with particular attention to consistency, clarity, belonging, and connection in a fully remote environment.

HR Business Partnership, Employee Relations & Performance Management

  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day HR partner to managers, providing practical guidance on employee relations, performance, team effectiveness, policy interpretation, organizational changes, and people decisions within established People practices and authority.
  • Manage employee relations matters, including manager coaching, workplace investigations, risk assessment, documentation, and recommendations for fair and consistent action, partnering with the Director, People & Culture on complex, sensitive, or higher-risk matters.
  • Administer and help continuously improve Jackrabbit’s performance management practices in partnership with the Director, People & Culture, including goal setting, feedback, development planning, reviews, performance improvement, and manager capability.

Learning, Onboarding, Offboarding & Manager Enablement

  • Partner with the Director, People & Culture to identify learning and development needs and translate priorities into practical training, tools, and resources.

  • Support and continuously improve onboarding and offboarding practices and create manager-facing resources, guides, templates, and communications that enable consistent execution.

HR Operations, Payroll Backup & Scalable Practices

  • Serve as a knowledgeable backup for payroll administration and partner with the Payroll Coordinator, Finance, and payroll partners to support accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processes.
  • Help establish and maintain scalable HR processes, controls, documentation, workflows, and service standards that improve consistency, efficiency, and employee experience.
  • Support HR technology, benefits administration, payroll, and other People-system implementations or transitions, including testing, data validation, process design, communications, and change management.

What You're About:

Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

We're hiring Licensed Psychologists (Ph.D/Psy.D) to conduct autism assessments for adults via telehealth. You'll join a team dedicated to creating affordable, accessible diagnostic services while helping to shape best practices in adult autism assessment.

Prosper Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who identify as neurodivergent, LGBTQ+, or BIPOC.

Weekly pay
$1,650—$2,200 USD

We also offer salaried roles that come with full benefits.

$100,000—$120,000 USD

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.

Blackbird Health is looking for SPACE-trained therapists to join our growing team. If you're certified or trained in SPACE (Supportive Parenting for Anxious Childhood Emotions) and passionate about working with anxious kids and the families who love them, this role was built for you.

SPACE is a parent-based treatment developed by Dr. Eli Lebowitz of the Yale Child Study Center and shown to be efficacious in randomized controlled clinical trials. It treats children and adolescents with anxiety disorders, OCD, and related problems, by working with parents and caregivers to change their own behavior, reduce accommodation, and respond more supportively to their child's anxiety. The child doesn't always need to be in the room. The results speak for themselves.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, and SPACE fits perfectly into how we think about care. You'll work with families navigating separation anxiety, social anxiety, generalized anxiety, OCD, selective mutism, panic disorder, phobias, and ARFID, among others.

SPACE (Supportive Parenting for Anxious Childhood Emotions) is a parent-based treatment program for children and adolescents with anxiety, OCD, and related problems — developed by Dr. Eli Lebowitz and validated in randomized controlled clinical trials. ABOUT CHANGING LIVES PRODUCTIONS:

Changing Lives Productions is the in-house video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, the #1 creator of scripted positive content online. With over 163 million followers and 82+ billion views across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, our videos receive more

than 1 billion views each month.

We produce several hours of original content weekly with messages of compassion, kindness, and altruism that resonate with viewers of all ages. Our stories tackle real-life challenges and deliver powerful life lessons that connect with global audiences.

Founded by Dhar Mann—named the “Moral Philosopher of YouTube” by The New York Times, a Time Top 100 Creator, and ranked #2 on Forbes’ 2025 Top Creators list—our founding principle is simple but ambitious: We’re not just telling stories. We’re changing lives.

BIG PICTURE:

We’re looking for a creative Short-Form Video Editor who can take hours of raw, unscripted footage and find the most compelling story within it. This is not simply an assembly role. The editor will make meaningful creative decisions—identifying the strongest moments, shaping the narrative, building emotion, and creating a satisfying payoff.

Our content ranges from man-on-the-street giveaways and surprise moments to emotional real-life stories and human-interest pieces. Most videos are approximately 2–3 minutes long and are created for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook Reels.

The right editor understands that great short-form storytelling is not just about cutting quickly. You need strong instincts for story structure, character, emotion, pacing, and audience retention. You should know when to tighten or restructure a moment, when to withhold information to build curiosity, and when to let an authentic emotional beat breathe.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:

Our Shorts team creates content designed to reach millions of people across the world’s largest social platforms. The editor plays a critical role in determining whether a great real-life moment becomes a great story.

You’ll shape raw footage into videos that immediately capture attention, introduce a clear emotional question, build curiosity and momentum, and deliver a memorable payoff—all within just a few minutes. We’re looking for someone who can think like a storyteller and edit with performance in mind, ensuring every creative choice supports both the emotional arc and the way audiences actually watch short-form content.

HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME:

  • Reviewing large amounts of raw, unscripted footage and identifying the strongest characters, moments, reactions, and storylines
  • Turning raw footage into clear, compelling 2–3 minute stories with a strong beginning, emotional build, and satisfying payoff
  • Making creative structural decisions rather than simply following footage chronologically
  • Crafting powerful opening hooks that immediately give viewers a reason to keep watching
  • Building curiosity, escalation, reveals, and emotional momentum throughout each edit
  • Editing with retention and pacing in mind, identifying where to tighten, reorder, restructure, or remove moments that may cause viewers to drop off
  • Knowing when to move quickly and when an authentic emotional moment needs room to breathe
  • Editing a variety of formats, including man-on-the-street content, giveaways, surprises, acts of kindness, emotional interviews, and human-interest stories
  • Using music, sound design, captions, graphics, reaction shots, and other editorial tools to heighten emotion and strengthen the story without making authentic moments feel overproduced
  • Creating alternate hooks, openings, runtimes, or versions for creative and performance testing
  • Collaborating closely with producers and the Shorts creative team to take videos from raw footage through first cut, revisions, and final delivery
  • Interpreting feedback thoughtfully and quickly while protecting the clarity and emotional impact of the story
  • Staying current on evolving short-form editing trends, platform best practices, and the visual language of viral social content

WHAT YOU HAVE:

  • A minimum of 2+ years of professional video editing experience, ideally working with social-first, digital, unscripted, documentary, or short-form content
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to find and shape compelling stories from raw footage
  • Strong creative judgment and the confidence to make editorial decisions about structure, pacing, character, emotion, and payoff
  • The ability to review large amounts of unscripted footage and quickly identify the most important story within it
  • A deep understanding of the language and pacing of TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook Reels
  • Strong instincts around hooks, retention, reveals, escalation, emotional turns, and satisfying endings
  • An understanding of emotional storytelling and the ability to recognize which authentic moments are essential to the story
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Experience using music, sound design, captions, graphics, and reaction shots to strengthen narrative and emotion
  • The ability to work quickly, manage multiple edits simultaneously, and respond efficiently to creative feedback
  • A collaborative mindset and comfort working in a fast-moving environment where edits may evolve based on creative feedback and audience performance
  • A genuine understanding that short-form does not mean shallow storytelling—the strongest viral videos combine retention-driven editing with authentic human emotion

WHO OVERSEES YOU:

The International Short-Form Video Editor will report to the Head of Shorts and the Jr. Manager for Post.

WHO YOU OVERSEE:

Currently, the International Short-Form Video Editor has no personnel reporting directly to them.

WHERE IT ALL GOES DOWN:

Our International Short-Form Video Editor will work remotely from their home or personal office and will be required to use Dhar Mann Studios’ time-tracking software to log and submit work hours.

WHEN THE MAGIC HAPPENS:

The typical work schedule is 40 hours per week. Specific working hours and scheduling expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

【岗位职责】

一、交易聚合与路由

1.负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。

2.设计并实现路由算法与最优路径选择策略，平衡价格、滑点、Gas、成交概率等多目标。

3.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障高并发与网络拥堵场景下的稳定性与成功率。

二、询价与做市商接入

1.设计并实现询价（RFQ / Quote）系统，接入链上池子、链下做市商、CEX 等多类报价源。

2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。

3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。

三、高并发与低延迟

1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。

2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。

4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。

熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。

6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。

7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。

8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。

2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。

3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。

4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。
