jobs.title: Client Operations & Yield Manager
jobs.excerpt: Kevel is transforming the retail media space with its cutting-edge, AI-driven ad tech infrastructure APIs that power the Retail Media Cloud™.
jobs.description:
Kevel is transforming the retail media space with its cutting-edge, AI-driven ad tech infrastructure APIs that power the Retail Media Cloud™. This groundbreaking solution combines the power of AI insights with API-based technology, allowing multi-brand retailers to build dynamic, customizable ad platforms while maintaining full control of their first-party data. With Kevel, retailers can deliver personalized shopper experiences, optimize ad targeting, and unlock predictive insights to stay ahead in an ever-evolving market.

JOB OVERVIEW: Kevel is the technology platform powering the next generation of retail media networks. We are looking for a detail-oriented Ad Operations & Yield Manager to join our team and work directly with our retail partners and their supplier communities. In this individual contributor role, you will be the operational engine behind retailer-run media programs built on Kevel: owning campaign execution, inventory monetization, and performance reporting on behalf of the retailers we serve. You will sit at the center of a three-sided relationship: Kevel as the platform provider, our retail partners as the network operators, and their supplier advertisers as the demand side. This is a high-impact role for someone who understands that context and can navigate it fluently, translating platform capabilities into real results for both retailers and the brands buying their media.

LOCATION: REMOTE - UNITED KINGDOM. This position is 100% remote. Applicants located anywhere within the United Kingdom are encouraged to apply. Applicants must be legally eligible to work within the United Kingdom.

PAY TRANSPARENCY:Kevel uses external, third-party market data to determine compensation for all open positions. Our compensation philosophy is based on the candidate’s specific working location and experience level. This means that we will take a no negotiationapproach in our recruitment and offer processes. We believe this is an important step in living our value of embracing diversity while underlining our commitment to fair, equitable and inclusive pay practices.

The annual salary for this position is between £40,000 - £55,000. An exact offer for this position will be determined based on the candidate's working location and experience level, in relation to our existing team.

All compensation packages include the additional benefits as described in the 'Why you'll love working with us' section below. We also have a transparent ‘Total Rewards Philosophy’ we’d be happy to share with you which describes our overall approach to compensation and benefits in full detail! Our recruitment team can share more about this with you in an initial phone interview and will be happy to answer any questions you have related to compensation at Kevel!

WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH:

Campaign Trafficking & Operations

  • Own end-to-end campaign trafficking for supplier-funded campaigns running across Kevel-powered retailer networks, from IO receipt through launch, pacing, and wrap-up
  • QA all creative assets and targeting parameters to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on schedule within each retailer’s environment
  • Monitor in-flight delivery daily across multiple retailer accounts; proactively flag and resolve pacing issues, discrepancies, and under-delivery risks
  • Maintain and refine trafficking templates, naming conventions, and ops documentation that can scale across a growing retailer portfolio

Yield & Inventory Management

  • Support retailer partners in forecasting and managing ad inventory availability across their on-site and off-site media channels
  • Identify yield optimization opportunities including floor price adjustments, demand prioritization, and deal structuring to help retailers maximize revenue from their supplier base
  • Partner with Kevel’s Product and Engineering teams on ad server configuration, auction mechanics, and new inventory formats as they roll out to retail partners
  • Help retailers establish and enforce inventory allocation policies that balance supplier demand with shopper experience

Reporting & Analytics

  • Build, maintain, and distribute recurring campaign performance reports for retailer stakeholders and their supplier advertisers
  • Develop yield analytics views tracking fill rates, CPMs, revenue pacing, and key monetization KPIs at both the retailer and network level
  • Conduct post-campaign analysis and translate insights into actionable recommendations for retailers to share with their supplier partners
  • Identify trends and anomalies across the retailer portfolio and surface them proactively to internal and external stakeholders

Retailer & Supplier Relations

  • Serve as the day-to-day operational contact for retailer partners and their supplier advertisers throughout the campaign lifecycle
  • Respond to trafficking requests, creative spec questions, and delivery inquiries with accuracy and urgency, representing Kevel with professionalism
  • Support retailer onboarding onto the Kevel platform and help them establish repeatable operational processes for managing supplier campaigns
  • Contribute to the development of enablement materials, best practice guides, and self-serve resources that empower retailers to run their media programs effectively

SKILLS YOU'LL BRING WITH YOU:

  • 3 to 7 years of experience in ad operations, yield management, or a closely related role at a digital media company, ad tech platform, or retail media network
  • Hands-on experience with ad servers and retail media platforms.
  • Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, or similar) a plus
  • Retail media experience (on-site sponsored products, display, or off-site) strongly preferred; familiarity with the retailer/supplier dynamic is a significant advantage
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple campaigns across multiple retailer accounts simultaneously
  • Clear communicator who can adapt their style depending on whether they are talking to a retailer’s media team, a CPG brand manager, or a Kevel internal stakeholder
  • Hands-on experience with actual analysis tasks, ideally recent, leveraging modern AI tools.
  • Experience driving better results for sales and operations teams, demonstrating accountability in yield management.
  • SQL or basic scripting experience is a plus but not required
  • A mindset of being AI and automation-first, constantly seeking ways to leverage technology to streamline tasks and improve efficiency.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING WITH US:

  • Fully Remote Team: We are a 100% remote work environment with employees located around the world. You are welcome to work from home, one of our offices, a WeWork office, or an equivalent co-working space.
  • Flexible Working Hours: We understand our employees have their own lives, responsibilities and working preferences. We trust our employees to communicate with their managers, and work when they work best.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits - Kevel provides 100% employer paid medical benefits for our employees and their children, plus comprehensive, affordable coverage for all other dependents.
  • Savings opportunity for the Future: Kevel offers retirement savings plans with employer contributions so employees can save toward future financial objectives.
  • Rest and Relaxation: Unlimited personal time off - and we mean it! We trust our employees to take the time they need, whenever they need it. We also offer Paid Holidays + a Kevel Holiday Break (from 12/24 - 1/1 every year!)
  • Kevelfest: Our annual corporate retreat! The entire Kevel team gets together once a year for a four - day in - person event filled with collaboration, team building, celebration and fun!
  • Home Office Stipend: You’ll receive a new windows or mac machine (your choice) + a $500 home office allowance to purchase what you need to set up your work space properly!
  • Parental Leave Support: We support all parents with salary continuation and benefits when our employees are growing their families.
  • Free press benefits: Kevel believes all employees should have access to legitimate news sources. You’ll receive a $300 annual allowance to subscribe to the news source of your choice.
  • You’ll work with an award winning team! We’ve won numerous Best Places to Work Awards for several years and counting! We’ve also won many awards for our Innovation, Business Intelligence, and our best-in-class products (Software of the Year, Cloud Company of the Year, Best Ad Tech and API Innovator).
  • Full transparency. We embrace transparency and encourage you to read more about what we value through ourCompany Constitution and Employee Bill of Rights, ourAbout Kevel page, andCareers Page.

Hiring Guidelines by Country: Kevel hires new team members in countries around the world. Some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Recruitment Team will share the specific benefits that are available in your location, and can help answer any questions about location specific eligibility requirements and benefits after the recruitment process begins.

ABOUT KEVEL

Kevel (previously Adzerk) offers the infrastructure APIs needed to quickly build custom ad platforms for sponsored listings, internal promotions, native ads, and more. We are committed to helping publishers drive new revenue and take back the Internet from ad tech giants like Google, Amazon, and Facebook. Kevel was founded in 2010 in Durham, North Carolina. We embrace remote working culture with our entire team being spread across the United States, United Kingdom, Portugal and Singapore! Kevel is proud to be an inclusive workplace with one goal in common — we want to make the internet a better place.

ALL APPLICANTS ARE WELCOME, EXACTLY AS YOU ARE

We’re building a global community - one that’s safe for people of all backgrounds and walks of life. Our policies and way of working are guided by our core values of inclusivity, trust, empathy, and respect. We know we have more work to do, but firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic selves. Kevel is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts and commitment to creating a diverse, inclusive, and transparent workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, safe and accepted. At Kevel, we embrace our differences and consider diversity a superpower that drives the success of our organization. Individuals seeking employment at Kevel are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Für meinen langjähringen Kunden bin ich auf der Suche nach einem Head of Sales (m/w/d)

Wir suchen einen Head of Sales (m/w/d), der nicht nur selbst erfolgreich verkaufen kann, sondern vor allem andere Vertriebler erfolgreich macht.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die vertriebliche Performance und Weiterentwicklung unseres gesamten Key Account Teams. Du führst als Player-Coach, entwickelst unsere KAMs individuell weiter und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Vertriebsmitarbeitern zunehmend selbstständige und strategisch agierende Umsatzträger werden.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, die schwierigsten Deals selbst zu übernehmen. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, dass dein Team diese Deals zunehmend selbst erfolgreich abschließt.

Aufgaben

Führung & Coaching

  • Du kennst die Stärken und Entwicklungsfelder deiner KAMs und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.
  • Du definierst gemeinsam mit deinen Teammitgliedern konkrete Entwicklungsziele und Maßnahmen.
  • Du coachst direkt an realen Accounts, Opportunities und Kundensituationen.
  • Du entwickelst deine KAMs insbesondere in den Bereichen Neukundenakquisition, strategisches Account Management, Value Selling, Entscheider-Management, Verhandlung und Closing.
  • Du bereitest wichtige Kundentermine und Verhandlungen gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs vor und reflektierst diese anschließend.
  • Du gibst Verantwortung nicht an dich, sondern an dein Team zurück und entwickelst dadurch Selbstständigkeit und Ownership.

Vertriebssteuerung & Performance

  • Du übersetzt unsere Unternehmens- und Sales-Ziele in klare Ziele und Erwartungen für das Team.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den KAMs Umsatz, Pipeline, Account-Entwicklung und Neukundenakquisition.
  • Du stellst eine belastbare Pipeline und einen realistischen Forecast sicher.
  • Du erkennst frühzeitig Risiken, Pipeline-Lücken und Performance-Abweichungen und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Maßnahmen ein.
  • Du führst regelmäßige Account- und Opportunity Reviews durch und stellst sicher, dass die richtigen Strategien und nächsten Schritte verfolgt werden.

Sales Excellence

  • Du etablierst klare und einheitliche Vertriebsstandards.
  • Du entwickelst Best Practices und sorgst dafür, dass diese im gesamten Team angewendet werden.
  • Du stärkst eine konsequente Akquisitions-, Wachstums- und Abschlussorientierung.
  • Du entwickelst das Team von reaktiver Kundenbetreuung hin zu aktiver und strategischer Geschäftsentwicklung.
  • Du stärkst die Ownership für Pipeline, Umsatz und nachhaltiges Subskriptionswachstum.

Player-Coach – ca. 20 % eigene Sales-Aktivität

Du bleibst selbst nah am Markt und an unseren Kunden. Rund 20 % deiner Zeit investierst du in eigene operative Vertriebsaktivitäten.

Dabei übernimmst du bewusst eine begrenzte Anzahl eigener Accounts und Opportunities, betreibst selbst Neukundenakquisition und arbeitest bei ausgewählten strategischen oder komplexen Opportunities gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs.

Deine eigene Vertriebsarbeit hat vor allem einen Zweck: Du machst Best Practices vor, bleibst nah am Markt und bringst deine Erfahrung direkt in das Coaching deines Teams ein.

Qualifikation

Du bist ein erfahrener Sales-Profi und hast selbst erfolgreich komplexe Vertriebsprozesse gesteuert.

Du bringst insbesondere Erfahrung mit in:

  • erfolgreicher Neukundenakquisition
  • strategischer Account-Entwicklung
  • komplexen Sales-Prozessen
  • Value Selling
  • Entscheider-Management
  • Verhandlung und Closing
  • Pipeline- und Forecast-Management
  • Partner- und Ecosystem-Selling
  • unternehmerischem und kaufmännischem Denken

Idealerweise hast du bereits Führungserfahrung im Vertrieb gesammelt oder möchtest den nächsten Schritt vom Senior KAM zum Head of Sales gehen.

Wichtig ist uns vor allem: Du kannst nicht nur selbst verkaufen – du kannst Vertriebskompetenz auf andere übertragen.

Was dich in dieser Rolle auszeichnet:

Du bist Coach und Führungskraft, ohne deinen Sales-Hintergrund zu verlieren.

Du gibst Orientierung, stellst klare Erwartungen und forderst Ergebnisse ein. Gleichzeitig verstehst du, dass nachhaltiger Vertriebserfolg entsteht, wenn Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Dein Führungsprinzip:

Vormachen → gemeinsam machen → Verantwortung übergeben.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose

A leading independent academic publishing company is seeking a Sr. QA Analyst to ensure the quality and reliability of its business systems. The ideal candidate will meticulously test and analyse our software applications to maintain the highest standards of performance and functionality.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

The job functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

· Own test strategy for features and cross-system initiatives, defining scope, approach, coverage, dependencies, and test requirements.

· Apply risk-based testing to identify critical scenarios, regression scope, and integration risks, and determine what should be tested, deferred, or excluded based on requirements and business impact.

· Understand end-to-end system flows and integrations, including upstream/downstream impacts, APIs, data flows, and system dependencies.

· Define and review high-level test scenarios for complex features and integrated products, ensuring coverage of key functional, negative, boundary, and business-risk scenarios.

· Work closely with Product Owners and Engineers from the requirements stage to understand business and technical requirements, identify gaps, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the lifecycle.

· Test complex features, integrations, and bug fixes using appropriate manual and technical testing techniques, including API and database testing, and investigate defects to identify root causes.

· Drive test automation by identifying suitable automation opportunities and independently developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts in collaboration with automation engineers.

· Assess test results and quality risks, provide input on release readiness, and proactively communicate issues that may impact quality, timelines, or business outcomes.

· Mentor and guide QA team members on requirements, test strategy, scenario design, integrations, and troubleshooting, and review their test coverage where needed.

· Represent the QA team in cross-functional discussions, clearly communicating testing status, risks, dependencies, and priorities, while maintaining strong relationships with Product, Engineering, and other QA teams.

· Coordinate integration testing for integrated products, working across teams to manage dependencies, test data, environments, and testing timelines.

· Contribute to improving automation coverage, QA practices, and test processes, including CI/CD integration where applicable.

· Contribute to hiring, onboarding, knowledge sharing, and QA process improvements, and actively participate in Agile ceremonies and team activities.

· Demonstrate ownership, curiosity, and sound judgment by proactively exploring system behaviour and business flows, raising risks early, and making informed testing decisions with minimal supervision.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Technical Skills

· Manual & Regression Testing: Strong experience testing complex features and integrated systems, with a focus on regression coverage and system dependencies.

· Automation: Hands-on experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts using Python, PyTest, and Playwright, with an eagerness to quickly learn new programming languages, tools, and technologies. Experience identifying automation opportunities and improving automation coverage.

· Test Strategy & Risk-Based Testing: Ability to develop test strategies, define test scope, identify critical scenarios, and make risk-based decisions on test coverage.

· Integration & System Knowledge: Strong understanding of end-to-end business flows, system integrations, APIs, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies.

· Requirements & Testability Analysis: Ability to analyse business and technical requirements, identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the development lifecycle.

· Technical Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems, using logs, data, and system behaviour to identify root causes.

· Test Management & Defect Tracking: Experienced in test case/scenario design, execution, defect investigation, tracking, and resolution.

· API & Database Testing: Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman/SoapUI) and SQL/database validation; basic understanding of performance testing.

· Agile: Experience working in Agile teams and actively participating in planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant ceremonies.

· QA Process Improvement: Contributes to QA standards, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.

· GenAI: Experience using GenAI tools to improve QA efficiency, test design, analysis, and productivity.

Soft Skills

· Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Works effectively with Product Owners, Engineers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and risks.

· Communication: Clearly communicates technical information, testing status, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Confidently communicates QA perspectives, challenges assumptions constructively, and influences technical and business decisions based on quality, risk, and customer impact.

· Curiosity & Continuous Learning: Proactively explores systems, integrations, business processes, and new technologies to deepen understanding and identify potential risks.

· Mentorship: Guides QA team members on requirements, test scenarios, integrations, testing approaches, and troubleshooting.

· Problem-Solving & Decision-Making: Uses critical thinking, technical analysis, and risk assessment to identify issues and make sound testing decisions.

· Ownership & Accountability: Dependable in delivering commitments, proactively raises risks and blockers, and follows through on responsibilities with minimal supervision.

· Adaptability: Responds effectively to changing requirements, priorities, and business needs.

· Team Representation: Represents the QA team effectively in cross-functional discussions and ensures QA perspectives, risks, and priorities are clearly communicated.

· Professional Maturity: Demonstrates sound judgment, emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to balance technical, business, and team priorities.

Work Requirements

  • Availability: Willing and available to work UK business hours.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.

What is Amplemarket all about?

Amplemarket's premise is that a lot of the playbooks used by B2B sales teams that worked 5 years ago don't cut it anymore.
In today's environment, sales teams need to have a tremendous amount of information about their prospects to decide when is the best moment and channel to reach out in the most relevant way. You can't do this with 5 different data/sales enablement point solutions that don't share the same data schema and barely communicate with each other. Amplemarket is the all-in-one compound solution that enables this.
Our AI-powered sales platform helps B2B companies generate more opportunities thanks to our advanced lead generation engine, hyper-personalized sequencing, omnichannel outreach, and AI-powered smart actions. We are backed by Y Combinator, and we are powering the sales teams at some of the fastest-growing companies in the world like Deel, Moveworks, H1 and Vanta.

Important Notice: Beware of Recruitment Scams

It has come to our attention that there are fraudulent activities targeting job seekers, where individuals are impersonating Amplemarket by using fake profiles, domains, and emails.
Please be informed that Amplemarket always uses our main domain (amplemarket.com) for all hiring and recruitment purposes. Any communication or offer not originating from an amplemarket.com email address should be regarded as suspicious.

  • We will never request personal financial information (such as bank account details) during the initial application or interview process.
  • Our hiring process does not involve transferring money or making payments of any kind to secure a position.

Amplemarket is not responsible for any loss or damage incurred as a result of job scams or fraudulent activity by third parties misusing our company name.

If you have any doubts about the legitimacy of a job opportunity with Amplemarket, please contact our HR department directly.

We advise you to verify the authenticity of any job-related communications claiming to be from Amplemarket. If you have any concerns or doubts, please contact us directly through our official channels.

Your security is our priority. Thank you for your vigilance and understanding.

Software engineers build the core of Amplemarket.
The three co-founders have an engineering background (João, Luís and Mica studied Physics & Computer Science at university) and deeply value the work that engineers are responsible for.
Our main goal is to build a sales platform that helps companies grow. Our product requires us to solve a myriad of difficult engineering problems very diverse in nature: from working on NLP models that can extract information from a thread of emails to scaling an elasticsearch cluster holding terabytes of data.
We are deeply aware of the importance of our tool to our customers and look for people that share that vision.
Among other things, our stack includes:
Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis
We don't require you to have experience in our stack to apply.
Our customers use Amplemarket on a daily basis. We keep and enrich valuable data that is critical for sales reps's success. We empower our users to engage with their prospects in the most personalized way. Luckily, you are reading this, and when you join Amplemarket will have even more jaw-dropping features.

You will:

  • Work directly with the co-founders

  • Ship new features every week
  • Own central, complex components of the application
  • Implement a scalable, stable, and user-friendly product that can handle our current growth
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers in the design, development and maintenance stages of the product
  • Drive and deliver on our product roadmap, turning rough specs into features
  • Find elegant solutions to usability problems

About you:

  • You have experience designing and maintaining complex/large/growing systems
  • When reviewing new system designs or code, you naturally think about what can go wrong: edge cases, failure modes, bottlenecks, migrations, releases, interesting metrics, etc
  • You love debugging and finding the root cause of production issues
  • You are proactive, when you see something broken you jump on it to fix it or suggest improvements
  • You strive to use best practices and always test the software that you deliver

Some more about Amplemarket:

  • We are a post-Series A start-up
  • Backed by YCombinator
  • Strong technical founding team from MIT and IST (also founders of )
  • Fast growing startup with product market fit
  • Great team spirit

We offer:

  • Annual Company Trip in a secret location
  • and more!
Amplemarket is committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all.
Regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, or if you’re parenting the next generation of innovators, we firmly believe that what truly matters is how your skills, knowledge and personality fit our company. jobs.excerpt: About Us At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

About Netwrix Access Analyzer

Netwrix Access Analyzer is a Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platform. It discovers where data lives across enterprise estates—Active Directory and LocalGroups identity, CIFS/SMB file shares, SharePoint Online, and more, and tells security teams what is sensitive data, who can reach it, how, and where that exposure could be dangerous. Our customers are CISOs, compliance and data-governance leaders, and the security analysts who live in the product day to day. They don’t want a data dump; they want answers: who has access to this sensitive share, which groups are stale or over-permissioned, where is data open to everyone, etc.

The Data Team

Data’s charter: provide world-class data storage, reporting, analytics, and visualization capabilities that enable customers to understand and act on their data security posture. That means owning the ClickHouse warehouse, the Metabase analytics tier (pre-built and self-service reporting) and the data infrastructure makes sure our application data layer scales as customer data volumes climbs.

You’ll go deep on both the data-engineering side (ClickHouse schema, ingestion correctness, materialized-view performance and scale) and the analytics side (Metabase reporting, embedding, self-service), prioritizing pragmatically rather than splitting attention evenly. You set the technical bar, build the automations and Claude configurations that let anyone (including AI) contribute safely. If you want to own an area end-to-end and shape how it’s built, this is it.

What You’ll Own / Key Responsibilities

  • ClickHouse schema, data model, and migrations
  • Materialized views, performance, and scale
  • Data ingestion, lifecycle & operability
  • Building reports and analytics via Metabase
  • Enablement & data storytelling

What We’re NOT Asking You To Own

While we don’t ask you to own these, we of course welcome you to be apart of them (and encourage you to!):

  • Connectors, the connector framework, or scan logic (what we call Discovery)
  • Detection, classification, risk scoring, and other security posture calculations. You materialize, report, and scale these correctly; you don’t have to author the domain logic that decides what they mean.
  • The PostgreSQL application database. It’s adjacent for your information, but not your center of gravity.
  • The core application, orchestration services, etc. The Core team is responsible for the application up until it connects to Metabase.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in data/analytics engineering, including prior tech-lead experience, with meaningful time owning an OLAP database in production. ClickHouse is ideal; Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, and others may be acceptable.
  • Deep SQL and analytical-engine fluency preferred. An understanding of materialized views, partitioning, and OLAP database design design are important.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and structurally fix performance and memory problems at scale. OOMs, read amplification, runaway joins, recursive/graph queries, and more.
  • Strong BI/reporting** experience: dashboards and a report-facing layer that real users depend on. Metabase is a strong plus; Looker/Superset/Tableau/Power BI transfers.
  • Comfort with Golang and Kubernetes is a huge plus.
  • Comfortable being the single accountable person for an area, setting the bar, and making pragmatic depth-vs-breadth calls without someone slicing the work for you.
  • Comfortable working in an AI-first team, driving real work through Claude Code skills/slash commands and authoring the configurations that let others (and AI) do the same.

Nice to Have / Preferred

  • Customer-facing and enablement experience — solution engineering, live demos/streams, technical writing, community/marketplace advocacy. This is a meaningful plus but don’t worry, the center focus remains technical ownership.
  • Data-science / statistics experience

Our Stack

  • Data warehouse: ClickHouse
  • Application database: PostgreSQL
  • Analytics: Metabase
  • Deployment: Kubernetes via Helm and ArgoCD
  • AI-first tooling: Claude Code

How We Work

We are an AI-first engineering team. The expectation isn’t just that you use AI to move faster — it’s that you build your area so that anyone, including AI, can contribute. That means well-shaped Claude plugins, automations, test harnesses, docs that encode the hard-won knowledge (the OOM fixes, the dedup gotchas, the serialization round-trip) so the next contributor (human or AI) doesn’t relearn it. Extensibility and open-source-when-possible are explicit product values. The team is small and ownership is broad: you’ll touch SQL, Go, Python, Helm and maybe even TypeScript in the same week, and you’ll set the conventions everyone else follows.

Our Values

At Netwrix, our values guide every action:

  • Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
  • Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
  • Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
  • Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
  • Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
  • Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
  • eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

  • Competitive Health Benefits
  • Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
  • Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
  • Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
  • Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: Our Commitment to Our TeamAt Pipe17, our values aren’t just words on a wall.
locationRestrictions: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
jobs.description:
Our Commitment to Our Team

At Pipe17, our values aren’t just words on a wall. They’re how we operate every day.

We are a high-performance team built around ownership, urgency, curiosity, and a strong bias for action.

We set bold goals, hold ourselves accountable, and move fast to solve customer problems. Every team member owns their decisions and drives outcomes. No one waits for permission.

We operate with urgency, but not recklessly. We focus on what matters most, take initiative, and course-correct quickly when needed. We value people who speak up, follow through, and take pride in their work.

Curiosity is how we get better. We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and stay open to new ideas. We don’t default to “how it’s always been done.” We explore, test, and learn. That mindset helps us adapt quickly, solve harder problems, and continuously raise the bar.

We also embrace AI as a force multiplier. We believe great operators don’t compete with AI - they partner with it. We use AI to move faster, think deeper, and remove friction from our work, while still applying human judgement, creativity, and context where it matters most. Thoughtful use of AI is part of how we scale ourselves and our impact.

Finally, teamwork is at our core. We win together, support each other, and celebrate our shared victories. Collaboration across functions is a daily practice, not just something we talk about. We learn from each other, improve constantly, and rally around our mission: unify commerce after the buy button.

If these values resonate with how you like to work, you’ll fit right in.

Location: LATAM

This position

ERP Solution Consultants, Implementation at Pipe17, working with our US-based customers, are involved in pre-sales, and actively taking ownership of the customer onboarding, and post-sales support work, taking ownership of the customer’s requirements and problems from start to finish. Pre-sales can involve requirements gathering and demos and on-boarding is one part project manager and one part implementation lead. Onboarding is the process of working with the customer and managing their migration to and adoption of the Pipe17 platform. Post-sales involves technical support and customizations and upselling additional functionality over time.

AI fluency: You’ve used AI tooling for work or personal use—or you are willing to dive in and learn fast. You explore new tools, workflows, and ideas to make things more efficient, and are eager to deepen your understanding of AI and use it regularly.

About You

You’re empathetic. You’ll be working directly with customers using our services as they encounter and overcome problems. You’re able to put yourself in their shoes and help point them in the right direction.

You can prioritize and have the ability to say no to customers. You're a self- starter, manager, owner (can drive things to results). You have great communication skills (written and verbal)

You like variety and enjoy multifaceted roles. As a part of a distributed team, you excel with minimal supervision. As a part of a growing company, you have an opportunity to make a big impact and build processes that’ll make your job more efficient over time.

You have experience within the ecommerce space such as one or more of the following: Shopify, Big Commerce, Woo Commerce, etc and B2B sales platforms, point-of-sale systems, ERPs, 3PLs/warehouse management systems, cart rover, order and inventory management systems such as Stitch labs, Brightpearl, Cin7, and SaaS connectivity solutions such as Dell Boomi, Workato, Zapier etc.

Responsibilities

  • “Own the customer” as the single point of contact, defining a success plan with deliverables, and ensuring clear communication across all activities of the customers’ post-sale journey
  • Be the main technical point of contact guiding the customer to leverage Pipe17 based on best practices and technical knowledge
  • Be consultative and build in-depth customer relationships and a complete understanding of their business goals and objectives
  • Lead multiple projects during the implementation phase and be viewed as an expert in solution design, development and troubleshooting. You may do planning, estimation, requirements gathering/analysis for larger customers
  • Translate business requirements into product use cases or technical requirements
  • Configure Pipe17 products based on customer requirements. Serve as a point of internal escalation on technical issues within the Support org
  • Perform troubleshooting and development assistance to Pipe17 customers and resolve problems when possible, engaging engineering as needed
  • Coach and educate customers to improve adoption of Pipe17
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Engineering, Product, Sales) to complete customer goals, be the “Voice of the Customer” to provide visibility and/or escalations, and maintain strong referenceability across your book of customers
  • Create and improve documentation to help customers and partners help themselves
  • Document onboarding steps for future reference and to transition to other teams as needed

Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of 4 years experience in the software/tech industry
  • Onboarding background - Customer onboardings with Netsuite, Acumatica or other ERP
  • Understand integrations (using REST APIs) with cloud systems
  • Experience with configuring SAAS products
  • Ecommerce experience highly desired
  • Mid-market focus on customers
  • Analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Solid project management and customer management skills
  • Experience with Order to cash flow: Products, Sales Orders/Cash Sales, Inventory, Purchase Orders/Transfer Orders, Returns/RMAs, etc.
  • Exposure to integrations with NetSuite (via Celigo, Boomi, FarApp or anything else)

About Us

Pipe17 is the AI-native Enterprise Order Operations Platform for brands and 3PLs. We replace the fragmented stack of iPaaS, middleware, and legacy OMS with one unified operational layer that manages orders, inventory, products, fulfillment, and exceptions across every channel and partner.

With 300+ managed connectors, AI-powered workflows, and an industry-first MCP Server for agentic commerce, Pipe17 lets brands go live in weeks, scale into new channels in days, and run post-checkout operations without developer dependency or systems integrators.

Our customers reduce operational costs by up to 85%, cut fulfillment errors by 99%, and launch new channels in days instead of months. Pipe17 is trusted by enterprise brands including Estée Lauder, Allbirds, e.l.f. Beauty, Made In Cookware, Wyze, Olly, Black Rifle Coffee Company, and Dude Wipes, as well as leading 3PLs including Ryder, FedEx, and Barrett Distribution.

Pipe17 is a venture-funded software company headquartered in Seattle, WA with a significant presence in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company is backed by GLP Capital Partners, a leading investor in ecommerce logistics, and with Series A funding.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Remote role within Argentina & Uruguay, fixed Term (6 months) RYZ Labs is seeking a skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our client's team—a pioneering company revolutionizing how micro-business owners transform their crafting passions into thriving businesses.
jobs.description:
Remote role within Argentina & Uruguay, fixed Term (6 months)

RYZ Labs is seeking a skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our client's team—a pioneering company revolutionizing how micro-business owners transform their crafting passions into thriving businesses. In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to contribute to the creation of a brand-new Data team from the ground up. If you thrive on decision-making, enjoy shaping strategies, and love transforming your expertise into actionable outcomes, this role is tailor-made for you.

Requirements

Basic Qualifications

  • Numeric defensibility. Given a dataset and a business question, you can produce the figure, say where it came from, say how it's defined, and say what would make it wrong. We will test this directly with real data.

  • An analysis that changed a decision. A specific piece of work where the business did something different because of what you found. What you looked at, what you found, what changed, and what it was worth.

  • A caught-error story. A time you or a tool produced a confidently wrong number, how you caught it, and the checking habit you built as a result.

  • An automation portfolio. Two or three recurring analyses or reports you personally automated, with what changed in hours saved or errors avoided. Rough honest numbers beat polished vague ones.

  • Writing we can read. A short executive summary of an analysis, and one example where you delivered a finding that someone senior did not want to hear.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field — Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or similar.

  • 5+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years as a Data Analyst, preferably in e-commerce or a comparable high-volume, transactional business.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for querying, analysis, statistical work, and visualization.

  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and conducting real statistical analysis, not just aggregation.

  • Working knowledge of data governance: source of truth, documentation, metric definition, and how to keep two reports from disagreeing.

  • Strong prioritization and project management — you can carry several requests without dropping the one that matters most.

  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, lean environment where nobody is coming to scope the work for you.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery) and dbt or an equivalent transformation layer.

  • E-commerce and marketing analytics depth: channel attribution, ROAS, cohort and retention analysis, LTV, promotional lift.

  • Exposure to apparel, distribution, 3PL, or another high-volume, product-based operation.

  • Financial statement literacy — you can read a P&L and ask a useful question about it.

  • Hands-on with AI and automation tooling (Claude, agentic SQL workflows, Apps Script, or similar) beyond occasional prompting.

  • Experience at a bootstrapped, profitable, or otherwise resource-disciplined company.

  • Experience mentoring junior analysts or reviewing others' analytical work.

About RYZ Labs:

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.

Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries,planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.

At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion, and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.

Our values and what to expect:

- Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer.

- Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated.

- Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility.

- Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone who interacts with RYZ with respect.

- Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less.

- Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way.

- Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, and our expectations. The status quo is not good enough and never should be.

jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

Tegus by AlphaSense facilitates extremely valuable calls between our clients and experts. Given the proprietary insights in these conversations, compliance is critical to our business, and a key component of our value add. The Compliance Team provides our clients with actionable insights while maintaining the highest legal and regulatory standards.

About the Role:

As a Compliance Analyst, you will play a crucial role in supporting our content generation while protecting our clients from potentially sensitive information. You will gain extensive knowledge of Tegus’ cutting edge compliance program to facilitate the review of expert call transcripts. This role is fast-paced, so agility and ability to work under a tight deadline are key.

Who You Are:

  • You are able to work from 2pm-10pm Pacific Time
  • 1-2 years of experience as a paralegal, legal assistant, compliance/financial/business analyst, or similar is preferred, but not required. Strong transferrable skills, such as research and analysis, are also highly valued.
  • Acute attention to detail and strong reading comprehension with proofreading, drafting, and investigative/research experience.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize tasks, manage time, and remain highly organized while working independently.
  • Thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and contribute to innovative solutions that support Tegus’ business needs.

What You’ll Do:

  • Review expert call transcripts to detect and resolve instances of material nonpublic and confidential information in accordance with internal protocols, applicable laws/regulations, and industry standards.
  • Complete due diligence review of each call, document any violations comprehensively, and escalate non-compliance with Tegus sourcing guidelines as necessary.
  • Conduct advanced research of financial reports and regulatory filings using internal databases and external resources to determine the extent to which information exists in the public domain.
  • Proactively manage internal and external communications while maintaining efficiency and adaptability in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.
  • Perform administrative tasks, including but not limited to, inputting, tracking, and maintaining accurate data on processes, transcripts, and workflows, while identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. The Manager, Regulatory and PV Delivery is responsible for developing the strategy based on regulatory requirements and for driving regulatory and PV deliverables based on an established PV and regulatory plan. They actively assist senior management in securing new business by participating to BDMs and
contributing to proposals/budgets. They also provide strategic regulatory guidance, training, coaching and mentoring to junior members; may be required to line manage members of staff.

Main responsibilities:

  • Assume leadership and functional representation for projects and/or deliverables of high complexity ensuring effective and rapid coordination and management and execution of regulatory tasks, driving the team to meet the agreed targets and to comply with the agreed procedures, trackers and templates.
  • Provide strategic input to internal and external customers and promptly identify and address any risk/potential risk by implementing preventive measures. Problem solve and ensure satisfactory resolution of performance issues or delivery failures.
  • Provide expert advice to Clients addressing complex queries and changes in local regulations/guidance.
  • Ensure all team members assigned to the project for departmental deliverables are aware of the tasks and time allocated, monitor project budgets, hours spent vs budgeted and promptly identify and escalate any OoS.
  • Assist in securing new business or repeated business by participating to BDMs, developing and reviewing regulatory sections of proposals, regulatory costing and budgets.
  • Prepare client’s invoices and review/approve vendor’s project invoices
  • Provide training, coaching and mentoring to junior members of staff
  • Support client qualification activities. Ensure audit readiness and assign team members to participate as departmental representatives for audits/inspections and provide responses to any findings/follow up questions.
  • Prepare and/or contribute to the Regulatory Newsletter and update regulatory database
    when new information is available.
  • Ensure collection, QC review and timely dissemination of all regulatory intelligence related to
    departmental deliverables. Support interpretation and impact analysis on legislation.
  • Foster professional working relationships with internal and external contacts at the local and international levels to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery
  • Drive department / company initiatives, act as a change champion and successfully manage implementation of the changes (communication, timing and implementation plan)
  • Minimum 3 years within pharmaceutical or CRO industry or Regulatory body, of which at least 3 years in a leading/project management role.
  • Proven ability to successfully manage global projects.
  • Expert knowledge of ICH GCP and/or GVP and most relevant legislation/ local requirements for territories of competency.

Why PrimeVigilance

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

remote

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.

We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

The Vice President, Business Development supports this mission by driving commercial growth through their own portfolio of client accounts and prospects. The role is focused on identifying, developing, and closing new and expanded business opportunities across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare organizations, with an emphasis on selling MAC's consulting, analytics, and primary market research solutions to address complex client business challenges.

Key Responsibilities:

Including, but not limited to, the following:

  • New Business Development – Lead proactive business development efforts across assigned accounts and priority prospects, identifying, qualifying, and converting opportunities for consulting, analytics, and primary market research engagements.
  • Account Growth – Develop and execute account plans for key clients, driving expansion through cross-selling, upselling, and identification of emerging client needs.
  • Strategic Selling – Lead consultative sales discussions with senior pharmaceutical and biotechnology stakeholders, aligning MAC capabilities to client business objectives and commercial challenges.
  • Opportunity Ownership – Own the end-to-end sales process from opportunity identification through proposal development, contract negotiation, close and oversee execution through strong collaboration with Consulting team.
  • Client Relationship Development – Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers and influencers across commercial, market access, medical affairs, clinical development, insights, analytics, and corporate strategy functions.
  • Commercial Collaboration – Partner with consulting, research, and analytics teams to develop compelling, differentiated solutions that address client needs and support successful proposal conversion.
  • Pipeline Management – Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting and achievement of individual bookings and revenue goals.
  • Market Intelligence – Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and emerging client priorities to identify new business opportunities and inform client conversations.
  • Industry Presence – Represent MAC at industry conferences, client meetings, and networking events to generate leads and strengthen market visibility.
  • Compliance – Abide by company operating procedures and client policy requirements, including pharmacovigilance.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree in business, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field preferred.
  • 10+ years of business development, account management, or consultative sales experience within healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, market research, analytics, or consulting.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently achieving or exceeding individual revenue targets.
  • Proven success selling complex consulting, market research, analytics, or strategic solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations.
  • Experience developing relationships with senior commercial, marketing, medical, market access, clinical, insights, and business strategy stakeholders.
  • Experience managing multiple opportunities simultaneously within a long sales-cycle environment.
  • Deep understanding of the primary market research, analytics, and consulting service landscape in life sciences.
  • Strong strategic and consultative selling skills, with the ability to shape and win complex, multi-service engagements.
  • Executive-level communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to coach and elevate sales talent without formal management authority.
  • Familiarity with drug development, commercialization, and marketing processes in the biopharmaceutical industry.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to translate market insight into commercial strategy.

Benefits:

A career opportunity with M3USA offers competitive wages, and benefits such as:

  • Health and Dental
  • Life, Accident and Disability Insurance
  • Prescription Plan
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401k Plan and Match
  • Paid Holidays and Vacation
  • Sick Days and Personal Day

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to continued growth, we are hiring for a Vice President, Business Development at Michael Allen Company.

Michael Allen Company is a Healthcare management consulting firm located in Darien, CT dedicated to helping clients accelerate growth by improving market and customer insight. The firm has a forty-year track record of helping clients achieve profitable growth, bringing unique analytic capabilities, experienced Consultants, and a customized effort to each engagement.

Areas of specialization include pipeline product planning and growth management, marketing and sales effectiveness, resource allocation, and growth strategy development for global healthcare firms. The firm enjoys distinguished industry presence in traditional pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms and medical product manufacturers. By leveraging primary market research as well as abundant data that is available in this industry, MAC Consultants work towards finding innovative commercial strategies that maximize the efficiency of the resources and effectiveness of the efforts used for products and services that enhance/extend/save lives.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager - Commerce
jobs.excerpt: About usHighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.


Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.


Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on ourYouTube Channel orBlog Posts

About the RoleHighLevel’s Commerce platform is the system of record for how our customers sell — what they offer and how it is priced, how orders get fulfilled, and how money moves: payments in, invoices out, and books that balance. It spans product information, pricing, taxes, and channels; fulfillment and inventory; and the full finance stack of payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger — together powering commerce for a global base of agencies and businesses operating at scale.

We are seeking a Group Product Manager, Commerce, to lead product across three connected verticals — Business Operations, Fulfillment Operations, and Finance — and the team of Product Managers who own them. You will set the strategy for the end-to-end commerce lifecycle, from catalog to cash, and be accountable for the coherence, reliability, and growth of the platform as a whole.

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who has managed and grown other Product Managers, and who can zoom from platform strategy down to the details of a pricing engine, a fulfillment flow, or a ledger entry. You lead through your team, raise the bar on product craft, and turn a broad, interdependent surface area into a clear, sequenced roadmap.

Your mission: To build a coherent, reliable, and extensible commerce platform — spanning what customers sell, how it is fulfilled, and how they get paid — and to build the team that delivers it, so HighLevel’s customers can run their entire business on us.

What You’ll Do

Set Commerce Product Strategy – Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap across Business Operations, Fulfillment, and Finance, translating a broad, interdependent surface area into clear, sequenced priorities.

Lead & Grow a Team of PMs – Manage, mentor, and hire Product Managers across the verticals, setting a high bar for product craft and owning their performance, development, and career growth.

Own the End-to-End Commerce Lifecycle – Be accountable for the full catalog-to-cash journey — product information and pricing, fulfillment and inventory, payments, invoicing, and ledger — as one connected system.

Drive Platform Coherence – Ensure shared contracts like the analytics engine, layouts, and reporting are designed once and reused, so the verticals compose into a single, consistent platform rather than a set of silos.

Deliver Business Operations – Guide the PIM, pricing, taxes, channel configuration, loyalty, and analytics roadmap that lets merchants define what they sell, to whom, and at what price.

Deliver Fulfillment Operations – Steer fulfillment, inventory, and the upcoming warehousing, time-clocking, and metering charters so what was sold reliably reaches the buyer.

Deliver Finance – Own the payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger/accounting roadmap, ensuring money moves securely and the books balance across providers and external systems like QuickBooks and Xero.

Own Outcomes & Metrics – Drive measurable growth in GMV, transaction success, merchant adoption, and reliability, using data to prioritize across a large and competing set of bets.

Partner with Senior Stakeholders – Work closely with engineering, design, finance, operations, and leadership to align on strategy, resourcing, and trade-offs, and represent Commerce in company-level planning.

Balance Delivery & Long-Term Bets – Keep near-term charters shipping on time while investing in the platform foundations that compound over the next several years.

Raise the Operating Bar – Establish the rituals, specs, and quality standards — discovery, prioritization, launch, and review — that make the team predictable, fast, and outcome-driven.



Who You Are

Experienced People Leader – You have managed and grown Product Managers, and you get energy from multiplying your impact through a strong, well-run team.

Platform & Commerce Depth – You have led product across commerce, payments, fintech, or a comparable transaction-heavy platform, and understand how catalog, fulfillment, and finance fit together.

Strategic and Execution-Focused – You can define a multi-vertical strategy and still hold your teams to crisp execution, ensuring ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.

Systems Thinker – You see the interdependencies across modules and design for coherence, reuse, and shared contracts rather than one-off solutions.

Outcome- & Customer-Centric – You balance business goals, risk, and trust, keeping the merchants who run their business on the platform at the center of every decision.

Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity – You are comfortable prioritizing across a broad, messy portfolio, using data to make sharp trade-offs without waiting for perfect information.



What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, including 2+ years directly managing Product Managers, and 10+ years of total professional experience.

  • A track record of leading product across a large, multi-team surface area — ideally in commerce, payments, fintech, or platform/SaaS — with measurable business impact.

  • Proven people leadership: hiring, developing, and retaining strong PMs, and building the operating rhythm of a high-performing product team.

  • Strong platform and systems judgment, with the ability to reason about how pricing, fulfillment, payments, invoicing, and ledger interconnect.

  • Experience partnering with senior engineering, design, and business stakeholders to set strategy, secure resourcing, and drive company-level outcomes.

Bonus:

  • You have owned a commerce or payments platform end-to-end — from catalog to cash — at significant scale, and can clearly articulate your impact on growth, reliability, and team development.


Why should you join us?

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

About the role

We are looking for successful candidates to be based on the East Coast. We are open to candidates in the US and in Canada.

The Head of Strategic Sales, North America, will build and lead Adaptavist's regional Strategic Accounts programme, reporting to the Head of North America Sales and leading a team of Strategic Account Directors and Strategic Account Managers.

The role is accountable for creating a repeatable growth strategy across Adaptavist's highest-potential North American customers, maximising wallet share by connecting executive customer priorities to the full Adaptavist portfolio, the two selling motions - DevOps & Developer Experience and Service & Work Management - and the strategic partner ecosystem.

This is a hands-on sales leadership role requiring deep Strategic Account expertise, strong C-suite credibility and disciplined account governance. The successful leader will create high-quality account plans, accelerate complex opportunities, build multi-year, services-led relationships, and develop a team capable of consistently growing accounts with >£1m in annual gross-margin potential.

What you'll be doing

Strategic accounts programme build

  • Define the operating model, coverage standards and governance for the North America Strategic Accounts programme in alignment with the Head of North America Sales and global sales strategy.

  • Identify and prioritise accounts with the strongest potential to deliver sustained strategic value and >£1m annual gross-margin contribution.

  • Establish consistent account-planning standards covering customer strategy, executive relationships, whitespace, partner alignment, competitive position, pipeline and multi-year growth objectives.

  • Create a clear portfolio view of account health, potential, risk and required investment, ensuring the strongest talent is aligned to the highest-value opportunities.

Drive wallet share & account growth

  • Build a growth strategy for each priority account that expands Adaptavist from point solutions and licence transactions into broader, services-led transformation relationships.

  • Increase wallet share through multi-year consulting, managed services, optimisation and strategic partner solutions linked to measurable customer outcomes.

  • Drive both DevOps & Developer Experience and Service & Work Management selling motions across the portfolio, identifying cross-sell opportunities and connecting customer priorities to repeatable propositions.

  • Improve average order value, account penetration, renewal quality and the proportion of revenue/gross margin coming from strategic services.

Executive customer & deal leadership

  • Build and maintain C-level relationships across priority Strategic Accounts, acting as an executive sponsor and trusted advisor where appropriate.

  • Coach the team to develop multi-threaded relationships across CIO, CTO, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement and business stakeholders.

  • Lead from the front on the most complex and material opportunities, helping shape value cases, executive engagement, commercial strategy and negotiation.

  • Ensure account teams understand the customer's business agenda and can articulate Adaptavist value beyond individual technologies or products.

MEDDPICC, pipeline& forecast discipline

  • Embed MEDDPICC as the common qualification and coaching framework across Strategic Accounts.

  • Maintain sufficient qualified pipeline coverage to support strategic account growth objectives and to identify pipeline gaps early.

  • Run a rigorous deal-inspection and forecast cadence focused on business metrics, economic-buyer access, decision criteria, decision process, paper process, identified pain, champions and competitive position.

  • Improve win rates, deal velocity and forecast accuracy by coaching account leaders on evidence-based next actions and prioritisation.

Partner & global account alignment

  • Develop strong relationships with regional partner leadership and partner account teams across Atlassian, GitLab, Harness, AWS, Datadog and other priority vendors.

  • Create joint account plans and co-sell strategies that expand executive access, pipeline and services opportunities in target accounts.

  • Coordinate North American account activity with global strategic-account programmes, ensuring a consistent customer strategy across regions.

  • Leverage the partner ecosystem to strengthen differentiation and increase Adaptavist share of the customer transformation agenda.

Cross-functional strategic account execution

  • Build integrated account teams across Sales, Presales, Delivery, Marketing, Finance, RevOps and Partnerships for priority customers.

  • Ensure early alignment on customer outcomes, solution scope, delivery capacity, commercial assumptions and gross-margin expectations.

  • Use Delivery insight, customer value realisation and managed-service relationships to identify and progress expansion opportunities.

  • Create clear escalation paths and executive governance for the most material customer, commercial and delivery risks.

Leadership, coaching & talent development

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of Strategic Account Directors and Strategic Account Managers.

  • Set clear standards for account planning, opportunity creation, executive engagement, pipeline quality, forecast accuracy and customer ownership.

  • Use regular one-to-ones, account reviews, deal reviews and skill coaching to improve individual performance and build repeatable excellence.

  • Recruit and retain top strategic-sales talent, maintain an active bench, and address performance or capability gaps decisively.

Business management & operating rhythm

  • Establish a repeatable cadence for portfolio reviews, account plan inspection, pipeline generation, opportunity coaching, and forecast governance.

  • Use data to identify account growth trends, whitespace, performance gaps and resource priorities across the portfolio.

  • Provide the Head of North America Sales with a clear view of strategic account performance, risks, investment needs, and expected growth.

  • Share best practices across the wider North American sales organisation and help raise enterprise account-planning capability beyond the Strategic Account team

What we're looking for

  • Proven leadership experience in Strategic Account sales within North American enterprise technology, consulting, SaaS, DevOps or adjacent ecosystems.

  • Strong personal track record of winning and growing large, complex enterprise accounts and multi-year transformation engagements.

  • Demonstrable experience building or operating a strategic/global account programme with structured account governance.
